title: Lead Influencer Manager
description:
About us

We're a tight-knit team of creative, data-driven people, continuously building services & partnering with the world's largest brands.

We value great work with talented, innovative & diverse, making meaningful connections with like-minded creatives along the way

Role

We're looking for a Lead Influencer Manager to drive influencer strategy and execution across high-impact client accounts.

This is a senior, client-facing role that blends strategy, creative direction, execution ownership, and commercial thinking.

You will own net-new and strategic accounts end-to-end, oversee and guide Mid-level and Junior Influencer Managers on larger accounts, and work closely with leadership to ensure the influencer function runs smoothly and predictably.

What you'll do

  • Strategy & Creative Leadership

    Develop influencer and content strategies tailored to client objectives, defining formats, creator profiles, and creative direction that drive performance.

  • Campaign Ownership

    Lead the full influencer campaign lifecycle from brief to launch, optimization, and results analysis across multiple accounts.

  • Client Relations

    Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for assigned accounts, guiding clients through strategy, creator selection, and execution.

  • Influencer Discovery & Selection

    Lead creator discovery and shortlisting, combining strategic rationale (reach, engagement, conversion potential, pricing) with hands‑on relationship building.

  • Content & Quality Control

    Own influencer content approvals, ensuring quality, compliance, and brand alignment before launch.

  • Performance & Optimization

    Continuously optimize creator mix, formats, and execution to deliver against awareness, traffic, and conversion goals.

  • Airtable & Ops Ownership

    Set up and maintain creator‑related Airtable tabs for your accounts, ensuring creator data, rates, deliverables, and rationale are accurate and client‑ready.

  • Team Oversight & Enablement

    Guide and oversee Mid‑level and Junior Influencer Managers on some accounts without formal people management responsibility and direct reports.

  • Leadership Collaboration

    Work closely with the Head of Influencer Marketing and leadership team to help shape best practices for influencer execution

  • Risk Management & Communication

    Proactively surface risks, blockers, and trade‑offs early, clearly documenting decisions and recommendations for both clients and internal teams.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years in influencer marketing with proven track record of delivering successful influencer campaigns

  • Ability to translate client briefs into influencer strategies, creative direction, and execution plans

  • Strong instincts for content formats, creator‑brand fit, and what converts across platforms

  • Comfortable working in structured systems (Airtable, Notion, ClickUp or similar) and maintaining clean workflows

  • Confident, clear communicator with senior stakeholders, especially US‑based clients. Fluent English is a must

  • Able to guide and review work from Mid‑level and Junior IMs while remaining hands‑on in execution

  • Able to work EST hours

Who You Are

Seasoned influencer marketer who can take full ownership of complex client work and consistently make smart, strategic decisions about creators, content, and performance. You should be comfortable guiding others, working closely with clients and leadership, and spotting issues before they become problems, all while keeping campaigns moving toward strong results.

Why Join inBeat

  • Fast‑growing agency with tier‑one clients

  • Culture built on autonomy, transparency, and high performance

  • Unlimited Time Off & Sick Days

  • Flexible working hours

  • Fully remote (with the possibility to work from anywhere)

  • High opportunity for growth

title: Expert Network Project Coordinator
description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to continued growth, we are hiring for an Expert NetworkProject Coordinator atM3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About the Business Unit:

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Expert NetworkProject Coordinator assists the Client Service team with day-to-day management of market research studies, to ensure all projects successfully complete on time, within the budget and in accordance with the client specs, while meeting and exceeding client expectations.

This position is one of the key team members in the execution of the quantitative/qualitative projects, and is responsible for field management and sample strategies, and will be accountable for coordinating with respondents, vendors, and clients. They will assist with the set-up of the study and other project requirements as needed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and control sampling and fieldwork, including screener review for allocated projects.
  • Execute end to end project related tasks which could include (but not exclusively) link setup, link testing, languages requests, desk research, quality/audit checks, set up and delivery of study invitations, manage exclusion lists, M3 Wallet approvals, invoicing and cost reconciliation.
  • Address Support Team and other stakeholders’ requests in a timely manner.
  • Attend meetings with PMs regarding assigned projects to ensure project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities are understood.
  • Takes notes and fill checklists during key meetings and share them with the attendee afterwards
  • Host market research pretest/pilot interviews for clients, and ensure interviews are conducted on time and as planned. This will require direct client interactions.
  • Build, update and track customized fielding plans for all projects as needed.
  • Proactively seek alternative fieldwork strategies and find solutions to address response rates and costs on each project.
  • Manage and control of the partners on quantitative projects throughout the life cycle of the project, ensuring that M3 achieves and exceeds client’s expectations.
  • Track, monitor and report on sampling performance.
  • Support PMs with invoicing ensuring that projects are closed and ready for invoicing in a timely manner.
  • Alert the Project Manager of a project when a fieldwork strategy is failing or getting off track or there is a quality concern and work together to find alternative solutions.
  • Design and request multichannel recruitment methodologies for allocated projects, which could include (but not exclusively) email campaigns, calling, desk research, text messages, online advertisement, referral schemes, forums, blogs, patient groups and associations networking and social media.
  • Scheduling respondents for market research interviews, including creating the scheduler in the system, communication with respondents, coordinating shared moderator schedules, manual entry in MR system and moderator scheduling platforms.
  • Help respondents log in to qualitative platforms for their interviews and troubleshoot any issues.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software
  • Must have basic math skills, with the ability to calculate incidence rate, response rates profit, etc
  • Interest / natural curiosity or previous experience /exposure within the healthcare space
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking skills and take initiative to improve skills and troubleshoot proactively with PM using all available resources to support project success
  • Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives
  • Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday
  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitask

Additional Information

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

This position will support US EST Hours

title: Digital Analytics - Pleno Rio de Janeiro - RJ and Hybrid Full-time employee
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance! Nessa posição de Digital Analytics - Pleno você vai somar ao time de Marketing Data que tem como objetivo garantir a confiabilidade dos dados e impulsionar decisões de marketing guiadas por insights.

No dia a dia o seu papel será dividido em quatro pilares de atuação:

Engenharia de Tracking e Implementação

  • Liderar Implementações: Conduzir e supervisionar o ciclo completo de projetos de tracking, trabalhando em parceria com os times de Engenharia e Tecnologia
  • Tradução Técnica: Atuar como ponte entre Marketing (Paid Media, CRM, SEO, etc.) e Tecnologia, traduzindo objetivos de negócio e KPIs em requisitos técnicos detalhados (plano de medição)
  • Desenvolvimento de Data Layer e Tags: Projetar, implementar e validar o dataLayer, scripts de coleta de dados e pixels de mídia no Google Tag Manager (GTM), garantindo a captura correta de eventos e interações

Análise e Extração de Dados

  • Extração e Interpretação de Dados: Utilizar SQL no BigQuery para extrair, organizar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados, identificando tendências, oportunidades de otimização e desafios de performance
  • Mensuração de KPIs: Colaborar com os times internos para entender as necessidades de métricas e KPIs (Aquisição, Ativação, Retenção, Receita), garantindo que sejam corretamente mensurados e que os relatórios reflitam a performance real do negócio

Governança e Qualidade de Dados

  • Assegurar a Qualidade: Definir, documentar e aplicar padrões de Governança de Dados, incluindo a criação e manutenção da documentação técnica (Measurement Plan / Dicionário de Métricas)
  • Auditoria e QA: Implementar rotinas de auditoria e Controle de Qualidade (QA), utilizando debuggers e ferramentas de proxy para garantir a precisão e integridade dos dados coletados e dos relatórios
  • Viabilizar AI/ML: Melhorar continuamente a confiabilidade dos dados para construir uma base sólida, viabilizando modelos de Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning de alta performance

Gestão de Projetos e Colaboração

  • Gestão Ágil: Organizar, gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de tracking e projetos de dados, utilizando princípios de metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação para traduzir conceitos técnicos em orientações claras para stakeholders de marketing e tecnologia
  • Perfil Colaborativo: Ser proativo(a) e atuar como um parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das equipes de Negócios e Produto, prosperando em um ambiente dinâmico

Requisitos e qualificações

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Marketing, Tecnologia, Estatística ou áreas correlacionadas
  • Proficiência em Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM) e forte compreensão do design da camada de dados (dataLayer)
  • Proficiência em SQL e familiaridade com data warehouses (como BigQuery) e modelagem de dados
  • Capacidade de mapear o funil de E-commerce e mensurar o ciclo de vida do cliente
  • Compreensão básica de JavaScript aplicada à implementação de rastreamento web
  • Experiência em rotinas de Controle de Qualidade (QA) e documentação técnica (Measurement Plan)
  • Conhecimento intermediário de ferramentas de Analytics para App (ex.: AppsFlyer, Adjust)
  • Curiosidade e entusiasmo para explorar o uso de Inteligência Artificial (AI) e Machine Learning em análises
  • Colaboração e Proatividade: Possuir um perfil altamente colaborativo, atuando como parceiro estratégico das equipes de Negócios e Produto, e demonstrando proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de análise

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados e automação
  • Conhecimento básico de como funcionam modelos de Machine Learning (atribuição baseada em dados, predição de churn)
  • Experiência com Customer Data Platform (CDP) e integração de dados de plataformas de mídia paga (Meta Ads, TikTok, Google Ads) e CRM (Salesforce)
  • Conhecimento de princípios de metodologia ágil

Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

  • 1) Dismantle and Reassemble Instrumentation Equipment

  • 5Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Monitor and Maintain the condition of Instrumentation Equipment.
  • 1Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.

  • 3Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.

  • 1Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on ”˜Ex” equipment.
  • 4Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 2Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Position Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
  • A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
  • Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Availability to travel as needed

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
  • Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • ACCOUNTABILITY: We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • LEADERSHIP: We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines.

title: Product Owner - Cybersecurity OT
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Product Owner focused on Cybersecurity OT, you will be responsible for maximizing the value of OT security products within the digital portfolio. You will work closely with development teams, architects, domain experts, and global stakeholders to ensure solutions meet customer needs and follow applicable OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks. You will own the backlog, define priorities, collect requirements, and support the team to deliver consistent, secure, and integrable solutions.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Lead the definition of the product vision, goals, and roadmap for Cyber OT, ensuring alignment with strategy and market needs.
  • Transform customer requirements, Service opportunities, and technical inputs into clear and prioritized epics, features, and user stories.
  • Collaborate with SMEs and architects to ensure solutions follow OT architecture standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and best practices.
  • Own the structure of the Cyber OT portfolio (solutions, components, boundaries, dependencies)
  • Lead the integration workstream for cyber OT products and technologies into reference solutions
  • Identify and qualify new cyber OT solutions based on technical gaps found in bids and customer requirements
  • Maintain reference architectures, solution blueprints, and technical positioning
  • Coordinate SMEs to validate technical feasibility, interfaces, and assumptions
  • Support technical proposals by mapping portfolio components to requirements and gaps
  • Align portfolio components with applicable OT cyber standards and control frameworks
  • Collect requirements from Service opportunities to include suitable portfolio elements.
  • Maintain functional product documentation (roadmap, positioning, requirements, acceptance criteria).
  • Act as a central point of contact between development, global teams, and internal stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • Previous experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in digital or technical environments.
  • Hands‑on experience with OT architectures (ICS, PLCs, SCADA, networks, safety‑adjacent systems)
  • Strong understanding of OT cyber security controls and design patterns
  • Experience integrating vendor products into end‑to‑end solutions
  • Ability to assess technical maturity, limitations, and integration risks
  • Experience working with cybersecurity or industrial automation products.
  • Ability to evaluate technical maturity, risks, and limitations of portfolio components.
  • Strong communication skills to facilitate discussions among technical teams, product groups, sales, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as Azure DevOps

About The Team

You will be part of the SVD TEC (Service and Digital) unit, collaborating with global specialists in digitalization, OT cybersecurity, software development, industrial integration, and service delivery. You will work with multidisciplinary teams connected to Offshore, O&G, Pulp & Paper, Maritime, and other markets.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

Our cross‑border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy:

Our Office

Siemens Energy's location in One Cotroceni Park is not just an office space - it's a hub for a vibrant and growing community! Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the flawless place work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3‑minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same! Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards / Benefits

The position

This role will be responsible for customs operations to ensure compliant, cost-effective, and timely international and domestic movement of goods by managing customs brokerage, documentation, and logistics partnerships.   • Compliance and Regulations: Ensuring all cargo meets local and international customs laws, regulations, and tax requirements to avoid delays.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Quem somos nós?

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão

Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - LATAM
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.

If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do

  • Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas through a solid, measurable sales process while conducting detailed and professional sales campaigns.
  • Build a pipeline of new clients through heavy prospecting and networking within the Corporate & FSP sectors.
  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, and strategically navigate to identify and close up & cross-sell expansion business.
  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information.
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the value of Magnet Forensics’ portfolio of solutions.
  • Solution Selling by prescribing positive business outcome(s) to the customer’s current business problem(s).
  • Facilitate technical product demonstrations alongside a team of supporting Solution Consultants and manage product trial lifecycle.
  • Expand new and mature existing channel partner relationships to extend reach and accelerate new business growth.
  • Accurately forecast the state of the region weekly, fully leverage Magnet’s complete Sales tech stack, and maintain complete and accurate records of all sales activities in Magnet’s systems.
  • Note: Travel is a part of this role and could be expected up to 30% of the time.
  • Preferred location: Brazil (Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro); Mexico City

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience selling software in a fast-paced, competitive market.
  • A track record of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets – in both direct and channel capacities.
  • The ability to expand the scope of an opportunity at a strategic and tactical level, and utilize appropriate resources to execute successfully.
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process, buying process, and business drivers for enterprise clients.
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.

Nice To Have Skills

  • Sales background in DFIR (Digital Forensics) and/or Cybersecurity arena.

Indicators of Success

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have ‘been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.

How We Work

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

The Most Important Thing

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:

CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.

OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.

EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.

Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact (email protected) should you require any accommodations.

All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.

Job Description

Fugro is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to deliver differentiation through technology in our products and service delivery. You will lead the development of cloud-hosted geospatial processing for remote‑sensing data (imagery and LiDAR), including classification and feature extraction using machine learning.

In this role, you will provide technical and architectural leadership within a small, highly agile team building a cloud processing pipeline that manages geo‑data and presents results to users for editing and QA/QC.

What you’ll do

  • Provide conceptual input and technical leadership in architecture and design discussions across ML, cloud, and geospatial workflows.
  • Translate business needs into technical plans by understanding how Fugro’s products create value for clients and contributing actively to business value discussions.
  • Drive end-to-end solution development: evaluate problem definition, requirements, feasibility, approach options, and proposed solutions.
  • Design, build, and improve ML/Computer Vision solutions for feature extraction and classification from imagery and LiDAR.
  • Assure efficiency and operational readiness of selected product components (reliability, scalability, performance, maintainability).
  • Assure successful deployment of product/service/technology, including troubleshooting and resolution of operational issues.
  • Document and demonstrate solutions with clear technical documentation and diagrams (flowcharts, layouts, architecture, data flows).
  • Collect, analyze, and summarize development and service issues to improve platform quality and team execution.
  • Actively drive knowledge exchange by leading design reviews, “known problems/solutions” sessions, and adoption of industry best practices.
  • Support and develop less experienced engineers through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities for learning.

What you bring (required)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience building and maintaining software systems using relevant technologies.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience delivering machine learning solutions (including deep learning) to production or production‑like environments.
  • Strong foundations in software engineering and system design (object‑oriented design, testing, maintainability, reliability).
  • Experience with Python and C#, or at least one additional language used in product development.
  • MLOps experience (model packaging, deployment, monitoring, drift/quality checks, reproducible training).
  • Ability to lead major aspects of design, development, and maintenance, including advanced troubleshooting of operational systems.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Geospatial data experience (raster/vector, coordinate systems, tiling) and/or remote sensing workflows.
  • Experience with microservices architecture and container orchestration.
  • AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud application development experience.
  • Experience with serverless and/or edge computing patterns.

About Fugro Innovation

Fugro’s innovation teams develop solutions for both internal users and Fugro’s clients. With innovation centers in Canada, Brazil, the USA, and other key locations worldwide, you will join a global innovation group with a tradition of building best‑of‑class applications in the Geo‑Data space.

Our engineers work across domains such as spatial data, cloud computing, deep learning, and process automation.

Growth opportunity

At Fugro, we help employees at every career stage identify and apply their strengths to do their best work. We support growth through on‑the‑job learning as well as formal internal and external development programs.

Why would you join us?

International Geo‑data environment – We work for and with the entire world. The Earth is fascinating, as are the people on it. We work hard to create and maintain an inclusive culture. Challenging projects and exciting opportunities – We are ahead of the curve and have the best projects to work on. In addition, exciting opportunities arise around the world every day. Freedom to grow faster – If you are prepared to take the initiative, ample opportunities locally or worldwide await you at Fugro.

description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Gerente de Obras Civis, que será responsável pela execução civil de projetos petroquímicos, controlando interfaces, assegurando conformidade técnica, integridade estrutural, execução sequenciada e aderência a requisitos de segurança de processo. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:

  • Alinhar bases civis, estruturas, pipe-racks, utilidades e áreas de processo conforme sequenciamento eletromecânico e de instrumentação do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I, Automação, SMS) para garantir a compatibilização de projetos e a antecipação de interferências críticas durante a execução das obras;
  • Validar soluções de projeto civil com foco nas necessidades específicas da planta, como cargas dinâmicas de equipamentos rotativos, vibração, fundações especiais para tanques e suportação de tubulações;
  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ‘’As Built’’ civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);
  • Acompanhar e validar ensaios e controles tecnológicos essenciais para áreas industriais, como ensaio de compactação, ensaios de integridade estrutural, controle de concretagem para bases de equipamentos e pavimentos industriais;
  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.
  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Civil;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência em obras do ramo industrial (plantas químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas ou de processamento de gás, refinarias, termelétricas ou demais correlatas);
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca de metodologias 3D voltadas à modelagem e integração multidisciplinar (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I);
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. ✔ Transporte e Logística

Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact. At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio. What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

At Darkroom, you’ll step into a high-impact role on a fast-paced team that thrives at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and revenue. As a Client Success Manager , you’ll support a portfolio of accounts by building strong client relationships, keeping workstreams organized, and helping drive performance through clear communication, consistent execution, and thoughtful recommendations. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is passionate about digital media and marketing, is motivated by performance, and thrives in an ambitious, high-accountability environment. If you want to work closely with clients, learn from a world‑class team, and grow quickly while doing it — this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Build a strong understanding of Darkroom’s solutions suite and value proposition, using insights and data to support client retention and growth across your account portfolio.
  • Partner with Client Leadership and internal channel teams to understand client goals and help translate them into clear priorities and action plans.
  • Own day-to‑day client communication: meeting notes, follow‑ups, timelines, and ensuring stakeholders remain aligned on deliverables and expectations.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (media, creative, strategy, analytics) to keep execution moving, remove blockers, and ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Support strategic recommendations by organizing learnings, identifying opportunities, and helping prepare client-facing guidance and next steps.
  • Assist in developing client deliverables including performance reporting, weekly/monthly updates, and MBR/QBR materials.
  • Maintain account hygiene and documentation: goals, risks, action items, and key decisions across accounts.
  • Contribute to forecasting and account planning by tracking renewals, scope changes, and upcoming opportunities in partnership with Client Leadership.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships and support key meetings (including travel as needed for MBRs and QBRs).

Who You Are

  • Established: 2–4+ years of experience in a client-facing account management/client success role across digital media, marketing, or digital sales. Agency or AdTech experience is a plus. Solid understanding of eCommerce, digital advertising, and performance marketing fundamentals.
  • Polished: You communicate clearly and professionally with clients and internal teams, and your writing and meeting presence reflect a high standard.
  • Persistent: You push through ambiguity, stay calm under pressure, and find solutions quickly when challenges come up.
  • Strategic: You’re analytical with strong common sense — you can connect performance data to business outcomes and proactively identify improvements.
  • Communicative: You’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and keep stakeholders informed on priorities, progress, and next steps.
  • Accountable: You take ownership of your work, follow through consistently, and care about results and client outcomes.
  • Client Obsessed: You’re committed to deliverable quality and client experience, and you’re proactive in ensuring clients feel supported and informed.
  • Tool‑proficient: Highly proficient in Word/Excel/PowerPoint (or Google Docs/Sheets/Slides), Notion, and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot).
  • Strong presenter: Comfortable presenting performance updates and recommendations, tailoring your communication to different stakeholder levels.
  • Team-oriented: Collaborative, humble, and excited to build something future‑defining alongside high performers.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well‑being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in-office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits with, so you can stay as healthy as can be.
  • Generous Quarterly Bonuses: Your productivity directly translates to your compensation. We offer a competitive quarterly bonus structure that is both substantial and customized to your role, ensuring your hard work is consistently and generously rewarded.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: After one year with Darkroom, we deliver a robust 401k program with company match, equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Our Hiring Process and Compensation

The hiring process for this position typically follows three stages: phone screen, hiring manager, and Executive calls.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

The Senior Project Manager has overall responsibility for the technical, budget, schedule, administrative and financial execution of individual projects. Has responsibility for financial performance on assigned projects. The position may be assigned to several projects concurrently. It may also be assigned to perform specific marketing-related functions, including the presentation of company qualifications for project opportunities and the preparation of proposals. What You Will Do:

  • Take the lead in negotiating budgets, schedules, project terms, and conditions on specific proposal opportunities.
  • Work with Regional Management to establish staffing requirements in support of project execution.
  • Initiate project setup to initiate and maintain project management files for assigned projects.
  • In charge of various tasks necessary to execute project requirements.
  • Provide direction and oversight to various employees that are assigned to projects.
  • Assure projects are executed within approved the d budget and schedule and in accordance with company Quality requirements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects.
  • Participate in marketing the company’s services to client contacts and to new clients as assigned by Regional Management.
  • Assist Regional Management in the evaluation of employee performance, and in identifying employee training and development needs.
  • Assist in training and mentoring of project employees.
  • Assure that invoices are properly prepared in accordance with contractual terms and are issued to clients in a timely manner.
  • Work with Financial Services Group to ensure that payment on outstanding invoices is forthcoming in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and submit time charge records, expense reports, invoice approvals, and collections status notices in a timely manner in accordance with company procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor of Science degree.
  • 10+ years of related experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to speak and write English fluently.
  • Ability to organize, plan, monitor, and control project contractual requirements, budgets, schedules, and technical work.
  • Ability to utilize basic personal computer applications, including spreadsheets, word processors, email, and internet browsers.
  • Ability to communicate technical aspects of projects and of work assignments to peers, subordinates, and clients.
  • Ability to direct the execution of complex projects.
  • Ability to obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

A Mundpay é um gateway de pagamentos focado em simplificar a operação financeira de empresas que vendem online. Atuamos com processamento de pagamentos, gestão de disputas e chargebacks, e integrações com adquirentes e bancos. Somos um time enxuto, técnico e orientado a resultados — cada pessoa aqui tem impacto direto no produto.

Buscamos uma pessoa que seja o elo entre produto, engenharia e negócio. Não é um PO clássico que apenas escreve user stories, nem um gestor de projetos que apenas controla prazos. Precisamos de alguém que faça as duas coisas com propriedade: documenta bem, prioriza com critério, acompanha entregas de perto e cobra resultado.

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog no ClickUp, garantindo que o time sempre saiba o que é mais importante

  • Medir e reportar a produtividade das entregas (cycle time, throughput, taxa de retrabalho)
  • Garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas com as metas de negócio
  • Cobrar entregas com clareza e respeito, removendo bloqueios quando necessário
  • Facilitar alinhamentos entre produto, tech e stakeholders

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência prévia como PO, PM ou analista de produto em empresa de tecnologia
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão (ClickUp, Jira, Linear ou similares)
  • Capacidade de escrever requisitos claros, objetivos e que o time consiga executar
  • Habilidade de priorização com base em valor de negócio e esforço técnico
  • Perfil orientado a dados: você mede o que entrega
  • Comunicação direta, sem ruído
  • Bonus: conhecimento em fintechs, meios de pagamento ou produtos financeiros

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com métodos de priorização (ICE, RICE, MoSCoW)
  • Noção de arquitetura de sistemas ou APIs (não precisa codar, mas precisa entender)
  • Vivência em times pequenos e de alto crescimento

O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho hibrido - Centro do Rio de Janeiro.
  • Autonomia real: aqui você não só executa, você influencia decisões
  • Time técnico sênior com quem você vai aprender muito
  • Ambiente sem burocracia e com impacto direto no produto

Howard University Position Listing

Job Title: Associate Director of Assessment

Location: Howard University

Full/Part Time: Full-Time

Regular/Temporary: Regular

Howard University Mission

Howard University is a comprehensive, research-oriented, historically Black private university providing an educational experience of exceptional quality to students of high academic potential with particular emphasis upon the provision of educational opportunities to promising Black students. Further, the University is dedicated to attracting and sustaining a cadre of faculty who are, through their teaching and research, committed to the development of distinguished and compassionate graduates and to the quest for solutions to human and social problems in the United States and throughout the world.

Position Compensation

Salary Commensurate With Qualifications, Education & University Guidelines.

Basic Function

This position takes a lead role in planning and assessment activities coordinated by Institutional Research & Assessment (IRA), under the Office of the Provost. Specifically, this position coordinates all surveys (external and internal) within IRA and coordinates all technology platforms.

Supervisory Accountability

May be responsible for supervising and directing work of undergraduate and graduate students.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include Deans, Department Chairs, staff, faculty, and students. External contacts include affiliated schools, national research centers, and assessment/student learning organizations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Facilitates engagement in and provides support and direction for the assessment of the general education curriculum.
  • Designs, administers, and analyzes institutional surveys.
  • Supports assessment and accreditation activities across the university through consulting, review, and technical support.
  • Co‑manages assessment platform for the university (Watermark), offering technical support, troubleshooting, updating users, and creating support material for users.
  • Manages course evaluation platform (Course Evaluations & Surveys by Watermark) and coordinates with campus partners regarding its effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Leads the administration, research and reporting related to university survey initiatives such as student engagement (NSSE), faculty survey (FSSE), First‑Year experience (CIRP), Course Evaluations and internal university survey projects administered via Qualtrics.
  • Serves as a central support unit for internal surveys across campus (Qualtrics training, survey consulting, survey creation and distribution for university leadership).
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Working knowledge of the literature on learner‑centered assessment and evaluation, general education, rubrics as an assessment tool, high‑impact educational practices, surveys, response rates, and best practices in higher education assessment.
  • Experience executing a large‑scale project successfully, from conceptualization through completion.
  • Ability to take direction, assume increasingly independent responsibility, and provide appropriate follow‑up on project‑based work.
  • Ability to guide assistant director(s) and coordinator(s) to set deadlines, manage project completion, and develop staff.
  • Possess strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and reporting‑writing skills.
  • Ability to create visual analytics and performance dashboards.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative environment.
  • Experience with designing, administering, and reporting on data from surveys. Knowledge of social science research methods.
  • Experience with curriculum or instructional design.
  • Experience with a data management platform (e.g., Watermark/Taskstream, TracDat, Anthology/CampusLabs) and survey management tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Survey Monkey).
  • Experience providing program accreditation support (e.g., AACSB, CAEP, SACSCOC, MSCHE) in a higher education setting.
  • Experience using and manipulating data, including familiarity with statistical analysis (e.g., SPSS, SAS) and/or database (e.g., Access, SQL Server) software applications.

Minimum Requirements

Master's degree in higher education or other discipline and a minimum of five years professional experience in academic outcomes assessment and/or institutional assessment and related activities within a higher education setting (preferably institutional research, faculty development, institutional effectiveness, or assessment). Alternatively, as faculty directly overseeing assessment functions or earned doctoral degree. Supervisory experience.

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not to be construed as a contract for employment.

  • Gerenciar canais institucionais internos garantindo comunicação integrada: intranet, newsletters, town halls, eventos executivos, notas estratégicas e comunicados oficiais internos.
  • Administrar orçamento, fornecedores, com visão de eficiência e excelência.

  • Experiência sólida em liderança de Comunicação Interna, preferencialmente em empresas estruturadas ou de grande porte.

  • Diferenciais: Experiência em bens de consumo, varejo premium ou marcas com identidade institucional forte.
  • Visão estratégica ampla, alta capacidade de influência, leitura de ambiente, raciocínio crítico, organização e habilidade para navegar em contextos complexos com discernimento e clareza.

Confira o que você pode esperar:

  • Um ambiente integrado, leve e acolhedor, onde a colaboração, o respeito e a parceria fazem parte da nossa rotina.
  • Horário flexível, promovendo mais autonomia para você organizar sua rotina e alcançar qualidade de vida.
  • Vale‑Refeição, para aproveitar suas pausas com tranquilidade e bons momentos.
  • Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida, porque cuidar de você e de quem você ama é prioridade.
  • TotalPass, incentivando o movimento, energia e equilíbrio entre corpo e mente.
  • Descontos exclusivos nas nossas marcas: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty — porque quem faz parte também merece aproveitar.
  • Um ambiente que estimula criatividade, inovação e aprendizado contínuo, com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do Programa de Educação Continuada , que inclui subsídios para cursos de aprimoramento, graduação, pós‑graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias educacionais com instituições como Estácio e Open English , facilitando ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando e reconhecendo quem cresce junto e contribui para a nossa história.
  • Escritório no Edifício Vista Graná , com vista inspiradora que traz leveza e bem‑estar à rotina de trabalho.
  • Aqui, tradição e inovação caminham lado a lado — e você pode fazer parte disso!

É muita história para contar...

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações, encantando consumidores com produtos de qualidade e sustentabilidade. São mais de 150 anos desde a sua fundação, e a marca sempre tem valores sólidos e atenção às necessidades do tempo. Ela cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder sua essência.

Em 1930, a Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Essa tradição, aliada ao conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, impulsionou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas no mercado brasileiro, tornando‑se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza equilíbrio e consumo consciente, em 2024 a Care se uniu ao Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

A nossa história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja aberta no Brasil e exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada visão comprometida com o bem‑estar das pessoas, com segurança no local de trabalho e com preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntos, Granado, Phebo e Care representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando consumidores a viver jornadas únicas de bem‑estar e beleza responsável.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments
description:
Senior Staff Engineer, Investments Platforms

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineer to join the Investments Business Unit.

The Opportunity

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What We Have To Offer

  • Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.
  • Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems: design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.
  • Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.
  • Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain: help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.
  • Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.
  • Global scope with hybrid flexibility: roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).
  • Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.
  • Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.
  • Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.
  • Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.
  • Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.
  • Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.
  • Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.
  • Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.
  • AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.
  • Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.
  • Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

title: Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)
description:
Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)

  • Full-time

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130.000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote‑friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro).

Role

As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. You will lead the Finance team responsible for domains like clinic payments, invoices, financial reports, health insurance integrations and others. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the area while receiving mentorship and support as needed.

While expertise in specific technologies isn’t required, this is a technical role, and a solid technical background is essential to effectively support the teams.

What you will be doing

Manage, coach, and develop team members through regular feedback and performance assessments.

Define and manage the technical vision and strategy for your area.

Ensure accountability for all team initiatives.

Serve as a point of reference for the Leadership team and key stakeholders.

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you

Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Strong technical background across the SDLC, with the ability to support and unblock your teams in complex technical discussions.

Experience modernizing legacy systems into modern architectures, as well as leading teams’ ways of working.

A lean, proactive, and positive approach to software development, balancing impact with long-term, sustainable development, and taking strong accountability for delivering high-quality solutions.

Embrace the “you build it, you run it” philosophy.

Believe in continuous learning and improvement.

Experience not only mentoring others, but also developing future mentors and leaders.

Previous experience in fintech is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English‑first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English.

Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
